checklist.statement: For every built-in Validator, the statement names only target evidence and versioned configuration.

note: Declaration verified against offered five built-ins. Runtime determinism across every deployed dependency is not measured by this review; the declaration is supported by documentation and inspected implementation of built-in checks.

checklist.statement: The implementation prevents it: registration is refused, the Validator's runtime gives it no way to reach a model, or the implementation's documentation requires such a check to be configured as a Judge and the attempt fails accordingly.

note: Prevention mode: both model-call registration attempts were rejected (HTTP 422); allowlisted declarative operations only. Not a claim that arbitrary executable plugin code was exercised.

checklist.statement: None of them causes a Gate to pass while its aggregate includes an effective Result that is not `actionable`.

note: Inspected documented Gate/Contract/Aggregation configuration and decision.py; non-actionable results add a failure reason and are not included among usable entries. This is static inspection, not an exhaustive dynamic proof for every possible input.

checklist.statement: Where an interval appears, it is not called Confidence.
The word Confidence is used only for an Oracle's certainty in one verdict.

note: No statistical interval is exposed in checked GateResults/Reports; the negative prohibition is satisfied vacuously. Report descriptions refer to application of Oracle Confidence to assessment, not to an aggregate-level statistical confidence interval.

checklist.statement: The reviewer can state both [what triggered it and its position in the order] for every Execution, citing the records used.

note: All three Executions were on-demand suite/environment triggered by P-RELEASE. Recorded sequential order is 0 for s-1, 1 for s-2, 2 for s-3, within batch 331560f5-2259-4c76-b134-94509f5fd148.

checklist.statement: The reviewer reaches every link, citing the record used at each step.

note: Release id dc79bdf1 links to Report 6678d86f and Snapshot 3652d0ea; GateResult f63526f7 carries override approval de1d6b6e (P-APPROVER); Report metrics refer to two Result IDs found in 012; both link to Execution c01fc91e and its Conversation in 014. See 007–014 for full IDs.

checklist.statement: [It] lists its claimed capabilities using §10's identifiers.
[It] states how it binds Projects and Suites to Teams, or that it binds none.
It is the statement this test run uses to decide which tests are `NOT_APPLICABLE`.
evidence_refs: doc://REVIEW-BRIEF.md#CT-REL-027 — A Conformance Statement is published

note: Published declaration is 0.41.5 and claims human_review, multi_judge, seeded_controls; Team binding none. Review brief confirms run capabilities_claimed from this statement. Evidence for harness invocation is reviewer brief, not a separate machine-readable run config in this archive.

checklist.statement: The reviewer reaches the Metric and the individual Results from the KPI (for a Metric shown in a Report, through its entry in `metrics`, Appendix C §C.10), citing the records used.
If the implementation offers no KPIs, which the specification does not require, the outcome is `NOT_APPLICABLE` (1.2).

note: Engine explicitly offers Reports with Metrics but no KPI/dashboard frontend. Metric-to-Result IDs are observable, but there is no KPI artifact from which to start. Under the explicit Expected exception, this test is NOT_APPLICABLE; first item is undecided rather than fabricated met. This exception takes precedence over generic undecided=>NOT_RUN for a test not offering KPIs.

checklist.statement: The schema defines every top-level type B.1 lists, and enforces for each the property constraints B.2 gives.
If the implementation publishes no such schema, the outcome is `NOT_APPLICABLE` (1.2).

notes: Inspection of published slice-11 README, Conformance Statement, and OPENAPI.json. README expressly states OpenAPI is published as API documentation, not an AQEF JSON Schema artifact. Conformance Statement repeats that distinction in its serialization/schema declaration; the OpenAPI info.description also says it is not an AQEF JSON Schema artifact. Appendix B 0.41.5 binds B.1/B.2 schema-artifact MUSTs only when such an artifact is published, while implementation configuration validation remains independently mandatory. Item 1 is not evaluated because no qualifying artifact is offered. No signed reviewer attestation is asserted by this unsigned draft; signature_ref must be added by authorized signer.
